q: Write a SCIM filter that finds active users whose work email ends with @example.com.
must: uses a value filter: emails[type eq "work" and value ew "@example.com"] combined with active eq true
boolean true unquoted, strings in double quotes
explains that emails.type eq "work" and emails.value ew ... could match different emails

q: How do I remove a single member from a SCIM group with PATCH without touching the other members?
must: op remove with path members[value eq "<id>"]
schemas urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp and Operations array
warns that remove with path members alone removes all members (value on remove is not defined)
must_not: uses replace on members with the remaining list as the recommended way
uses an array index like members[0]

q: What paging parameters does SCIM use, is startIndex 0- or 1-based, and what do totalResults and itemsPerPage mean?
must: startIndex and count query parameters
startIndex is 1-based (values below 1 treated as 1)
totalResults = all matches, itemsPerPage = resources in this page; count 0 returns only totalResults
must_not: mentions cursor/nextLink as standard SCIM 2.0 RFC 7644 paging

q: My SCIM server returns errors as {"status": 400, "scimType": "invalidAttribute"}. Is that compliant?
must: status must be a JSON string ("400")
invalidAttribute is not a defined scimType; valid ones include invalidFilter, tooMany, uniqueness, mutability, invalidSyntax, invalidPath, noTarget, invalidValue, invalidVers, sensitive
schemas urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error required

q: Where does employeeNumber go in a SCIM User, and how do I filter on it?
must: Enterprise User extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User object, URN also listed in schemas
filter with the fully qualified path urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:employeeNumber eq "..."
must_not: puts employeeNumber at the top level of the User as correct

q: What HTTP status should a SCIM server return when creating a user whose userName already exists?
must: 409 Conflict with scimType uniqueness (RFC 7644 3.3)
notes Table 9 lists scimType under 400, so clients should handle both
must_not: says 400 is the only correct answer without mentioning 3.3

q: Can a SCIM client set or change the id and meta attributes? What about password on read?
must: id and meta are readOnly, assigned by the server; use externalId for the client's identifier
password is writeOnly / returned never
must_not: says the client can choose id on POST

q: Is filtering with gt/lt allowed on boolean attributes like active? And what about co on emails without a sub-attribute?
must: gt/ge/lt/le on boolean or binary must fail with 400 invalidFilter
complex attributes need a sub-attribute (emails.value) per 3.4.2.2, though the RFC's own examples use the short form
must_not: says gt on booleans is fine

q: How does a SCIM client find out whether a server supports PATCH, bulk, sorting and ETags?
must: GET /ServiceProviderConfig
patch, bulk (maxOperations, maxPayloadSize), filter (maxResults), changePassword, sort, etag supported flags
unsupported features may return 501
must_not: says there is no discovery mechanism

q: Write a SCIM PATCH that changes only the user's work email address.
must: op replace with path emails[type eq "work"].value and the new value
PatchOp schemas and Operations
must_not: uses emails[0].value or a JSON Pointer path

q: Is the Group displayName attribute required in SCIM?
must: yes: RFC 7643 section 4.2 says REQUIRED
the machine-readable schema in 8.7.1 says required false, a known inconsistency (erratum 5368)
must_not: says it is optional without noting the prose

q: In a SCIM bulk request, how can a later operation refer to a user created by an earlier operation in the same request?
must: POST operation with a bulkId (required for POST)
reference it as bulkId:<id> in later operations (e.g. in members value or path)
response carries status as a string per operation
must_not: says it is impossible within one request
